title: JourneyLite Accepts Most Insurance Plans For Weight Loss Surgery
seoTitle: JourneyLite Accepts Most Insurance Plans For Weight Loss Surgery
metaDescription: Wondering if your insurance will cover weight loss surgery? JourneyLite works with most major insurance plans — Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, United & more — plus many Medicaid and Medicare policies. Learn if you qualify.
excerpt: Wondering if your insurance will cover weight loss surgery? JourneyLite works with most major insurance plans — Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, United & more — plus many Medicaid and Medicare policies. Learn if you qualify.
author: DrCurry
bodyHtml:
Are you planning on using your insurance for weight loss surgery? No problem!

Some patients aren’t even aware that weight loss surgery is often a covered benefit, providing that they meet their policy requirements.  Insurance should cover because weight loss surgery not only benefits the patient, but also often times the insurance carrier.  Why? Because after surgery a patient might see many of their weight-related medical issues resolve completely.  Now the insurance company doesn’t have to pay for diabetes meds and CPAP machines!

If you’re thinking about having weight loss surgery in Ohio, Kentucky, or Indiana you can rest assured that JourneyLite is your trusted team, even if you’re going through your insurance. JourneyLite Physicians and JourneyLite Surgery Center are both in-network with almost every major private insurance company! This includes:

          • Aetna – JourneyLite is an Aetna Institue of Quality

          • Anthem/Blue Cross-Blue Shield – JourneyLite is a Blue Distinction Plus Center

          • Cigna

          • Humana

          • Medical Mutual

          • Surgery Plus

          • Transcarent

          • United Healthcare – JourneyLite is an Optum Center of Excellence

In addition, we are also on most Medicaid and Medicare plans as well.

Not all plans will have coverage. If you’re not sure if your insurance covers weight loss surgery, just click here and we can help you find out about your coverage.

Some plans will have an exclusion for weight loss surgery. If you already know you don’t have coverage don’t give up, as we have transparent self-pay pricing which you can see here.

If you find this all too confusing and you’d like to talk to one of our expert patient service representatives about your options, just give us a call at (513) 559-1222!

Or just click to make an appointment and one of our team members will call you back to discuss your options!
